title: Chapter 1471
text:
Supers Holy Land, a certain no man's land.

A ball of colorful energy floated in space. Its shape was unpredictable, like a colorful cloud that was kneaded by an invisible force. All kinds of high-energy particles flowed through it like electric signals released by neurons. The entire energy ball was like a small nebula-like energy field-type brain.

Evans floated in the middle with a serious expression. He carefully controlled all kinds of energy and constantly perfected this nebula brain.

However, all of a sudden, the energy nebula expanded unstable. The nerve bridges built by all kinds of energy collapsed in a chain reaction.

Just as the energy nebula was about to expand and explode, Evans crossed his hands and opened his Esper Field. The violent energy suddenly stabilized and quickly shrank, turning into a dazzling ball of light the size of a human head that was absorbed by Evans.

"Sigh, I failed again …"

Evans had a helpless expression as he sighed inwardly.

Ever since he saw the battle of the Transcendent Grade in the war, he had deeply felt the inadequacy of his strength and had always yearned for that incredible power.

Originally, after the war ended, everyone started to take a break, but Evans was one of the very few people who did not relax and had been focusing on developing his Esper Ability.

On one hand, his motivation was his own pursuit. On the other hand, Evans still remembered the high hopes that Black Star had for him and was not willing to waste his hard-earned potential. He wanted to reach the level that Black Star had expected.

EsGod, on the other hand, was very gratified by this. He thought that Evans had always remembered the promise to help him beat up Black Star and had always taught him everything he knew and guided Evans' cultivation.

"I hope I can improve as soon as possible. His Excellency Black Star told me that he hopes that I will be a pillar of the Supers Holy Land in the future. I can't disappoint him …"

Evans clenched his fists and encouraged himself.

Just as he was about to try again, his perception suddenly moved and he looked in a direction.

A stream of light approached from afar, and a spaceship jumped over and hovered not far away. A strong figure flew out. It was Carrott.

"Eh, so you're here. I was wondering when there was an additional high-energy reaction area in the territory."

Carrott was surprised to see Evans and took the initiative to talk to him.

"Uh, hello." Evans hesitated for a moment. He nodded and greeted him.

Even though both of them were members of the Black Star Corps, they were not members of the Black Star Corps. However, they didn't interact much with each other and only knew each other's basic information. They were just acquaintances.

"What are you doing here?" Evans was curious.

"Am I looking for an extreme environment to temper my body? The spaceship sensed a high-energy reaction, so I came over? So it was you who was training. No wonder. "

"Oh? So that's how it is … "

The two of them were not familiar with each other? He braced himself and chatted awkwardly for a while. When he realized that there was nothing to talk about, he gradually fell silent.

But no one left. Staring at each other? The atmosphere slowly became strange.

Speaking of which? When the two of them were cultivating in seclusion, they had always thought that they were the only seeded contestants who had received special treatment from Black Star. It was only after they came out of seclusion that they were surprised to learn of Black Star's existence and realized that they were not the only one.

Such a relationship? This caused the two of them to have very subtle thoughts about each other. On one hand, they were curious about each other's background. On the other hand, he was curious about what Black Star saw in her …

This kind of mentality was roughly equivalent to two top students in a class. All of them had received special treatment from their teacher, so they subconsciously developed competitive instincts …

After a long time? Carrott coughed dryly. Broke the silence? He tried to speak.

"Why don't … the two of us practice?"

"… Sounds good."

Evans and Carrott's eyes met in midair, and sparks seemed to fly.

Black Star Corps Headquarters, Fleet Commander's Office.

Herlous sat on the sofa with his legs crossed, looked at the few Sunils in front of him, and pushed the wine glass on the table with his finger.

"Drink a little?"

"No need, Your Excellency Herlous."

Herlous did not mind. He sized up the leader of the Sunils, nodded, and said, "You are the leader of the Sunils.

"You must be this generation's Sunil leader. Not bad, not bad. The previous leader mentioned you to me before, saying that you are very smart and capable."

"You flatter me." The leader nodded.

The Sunils were Herlous' race. Ever since the rise of the Black Star Corps, Herlous, as the earliest elder, had a lot of power, and he had provided a lot of resources to his race within his power.

Therefore, every generation of Sunil leaders would come to visit him, and this generation was no exception.

"Since you've become the leader, then do your best."

Herlous encouraged. He then looked at the few young Sunils behind him, raised his brows, and said, "Don't worry.

"These are …"

"Your Excellency Herlous, these are a few young people with potential in my immediate family. They wish to enter the Black Star Corps to train. Please take care of them," the Sunil leader said respectfully.

Herlous sized them up. The youths immediately puffed out their chests and raised their heads nervously.

Seeing this, Herlous shook his head and said, "The army has a new leader. Nero is in charge now, but the standards are still as strict as before. I can make them official members, but whether they can climb up the ranks will depend on their own abilities."

"Thank you, Your Excellency." The Sunil leader bowed.

Herlous waved his hand, indicating that there was no need for formalities. After a pause, he suddenly changed the topic.

"From today onwards, don't come to visit me anymore. It's time for you to be more independent. Leave now."

The Sunil leader's body trembled slightly. His expression was complicated, but he did not say anything. He lowered his head and left with his people.

After the group left, another person walked in. It was Sylvia. She had been eavesdropping outside for quite some time.

"Not bad. You finally decided not to use your position for personal gain," Sylvia teased.

"Nonsense. I've always been thinking for the army." Herlous rolled his eyes.

"I'm just joking. But I'm curious. Why aren't you helping the race anymore?" Sylvia blinked.

"They can't always rely on me, or they'll become dependent on me sooner or later. After almost a hundred years, the habits cultivated by generations have already shown signs of this. I can't just turn a blind eye to it." Herlous shook his head and said with a deep voice, "Plus … Black Star used to tolerate me, but now that there's someone else in power, I can't be insensible in the future."

Sylvia curled her lips and did not say anything. She stood in front of the window with her hands behind her back and looked at the bright galaxy outside.

Suddenly, she sighed and said, "In the blink of an eye, it's been a hundred years …"

Herlous also turned to look outside the window and sighed. "Yes, it's been a hundred years … We actually followed Black Star to where we are today. Sometimes, thinking about it, it really feels like a dream. If Black Star didn't invite me back then, I might've spent the rest of my life in my own little tavern. "

"If I didn't meet him …" Sylvia paused, shook her head, and said, "Maybe I would've died in some corner of the universe long ago. The life we're living now is not something we could've dreamed of in the past …"

The two of them looked outside the window quietly and did not say anything else, silently savoring their memories.

…

In the peaceful times, time passed even more quietly. In the blink of an eye, another few months had passed.

On this day, in the joint conference room of the three Universal Civilizations.

"Recently, the hearts of the direct Beyond Grade As have been wavering. The expansion of the Supers Holy Land is too shocking."

"Fortunately, Clottey, Oulou, and the others have stabilized the situation. Otherwise, there would be another direct descendant who would join the Supers Holy Land."

The leaders of the three Universal Civilizations sighed bitterly.

The Supers Holy Land had broken the old pattern. As the original beneficiaries, they naturally could not feel comfortable, but they could only silently endure the waves of impact.

"Speaking of which, Black Star hasn't appeared recently. Didn't he already complete the Sanctum Revival? What has he been busy with recently?" The Ethereal Pope was curious.

"Who knows? I can't get any information anyway." Marbruce was helpless.

"It's not a good idea for him to disappear for so long. If the Star Alliance sends new spies and Black Star happens to not be around, I'm afraid we'll be exposed."

"Speaking of which, if Black Star is willing to help, as long as he controls the leaders of the Star Alliance, we can win very easily. Unfortunately, he doesn't want to help."

"Heh, with Black Star's personality, there's nothing absolute. I think the price is not enough. As long as we offer some conditions, he should still agree."

"Makes sense, but his appetite is very big now. We have to think about what chips we can use to move him …"

Just as the three of them were discussing how to pull Han Xiao to invade the Star Alliance, a remote projection suddenly appeared in the room. It was Han Xiao.

The three of them were shocked.

"Black Star? You … You're back. Why didn't you inform us … "Marbruce was halfway through his sentence when he came back to his senses. He frowned and said unhappily," Hey! You didn't hack the dynasty's database again, did you? "

Han Xiao ignored Marbruce's dissatisfaction. Instead, he looked at the three of them with a strange gaze and slowly said, "I came here to share the Sanctum.

"I'm here this time to share the Sanctums' information. Everyone can develop it together. If you're not willing, then I'll leave."

The three of them were stunned.

"Are you serious? Are you really going to bring us along to develop the Sanctum? "

Louis's tone was hesitant and filled with disbelief. He had thought that Black Star was joking.

Han Xiao nodded, but he suddenly changed the topic and said in a meaningful tone,

"But before we work together, I have something to tell you … Don't be afraid of what I'm going to say next …"

"Afraid?"

The Ethereal Pope was a little amused and did not think much of it.

"We've even experienced an enemy like the World Tree. What else can we be afraid of? Just say it. We've all been through a lot. You won't scare us. "

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows with a playful expression.
